Privacy.intro: {siteName} (hereinafter 'the Service') is a neutral price comparison tool. We value your privacy and handle your information in a transparent, accountable way.
Privacy.collectAccount: <bold>Account information</bold>: When you sign in with Google, we receive your email, display name, and avatar; when you sign in via email magic link, we record only your email. This is used for identity verification and quota management.
Privacy.collectUsage: <bold>Usage logs</bold>: We record the list of Apps you have looked up and your view counts, used for quota accounting and service optimization.
Privacy.collectTech: <bold>Technical information</bold>: Automatically collected IP address, browser type, and device model, used solely for anti-abuse and security protection.
Privacy.notDo1: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing
Privacy.notDo2: We do not track your activity on other websites
Privacy.notDo3: We do not send you spam or unsolicited promotions
Privacy.cookieBody: The Service uses necessary cookies and local storage to keep you signed in and remember your currency and region preferences. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party advertising cookies.
Privacy.retentionBody: Your account data is retained for the lifetime of your account. To delete your account and all associated data, contact us via GitHub Issues - we will process it within 7 business days.
Privacy.securityBody: We take reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data, including encrypted transmission, access controls, and regular security audits. However, please note: no internet transmission method can be guaranteed 100% secure.
Privacy.contactBody: For any privacy-related questions, contact us via GitHub Issues.

About.metaDescription: Learn the background, intent, core features, and how-to of {siteName} - a tool that finds you the cheapest App Store region for any subscription.
About.title: About Us
About.subtitle: Helping you find the single cheapest App Store region for any subscription.
About.backgroundBody: The same app is often priced several times differently across App Store regions. Exchange rates between dollars, euros, and yen shift daily, and local pricing varies - yet almost no one manually compares dozens of regions before subscribing. {siteName} exists to fix exactly that: gather prices scattered across 40 App Store regions into one table.
About.intentBody: We believe an information gap is the most overlooked cost in the consumer experience. When a yearly subscription costs just a few dozen in the cheapest region but several hundred in the priciest, simply knowing the gap is itself valuable. We built this tool to make pricing transparent - so that before anyone subscribes, they can see at a glance whether the region they're in is actually the best deal.
About.featuresIntro: Focused on one thing - cross-region App Store price comparison - done to the hilt:
About.feature1Body: From the US, Japan, and Turkey to India and Brazil - one query concurrently fetches subscription and IAP prices across 40 App Store regions, converted into the currency you choose.
About.feature2Body: Monthly / yearly subscriptions, one-time purchases, Family Sharing - any in-app purchase tier shown publicly on the App Store detail page is broken down into comparable rows.
About.feature3Body: All prices are converted at live FX rates into a single currency, then sorted lowest first. The cheapest, the priciest, and your own region are highlighted - the gap is right there.
About.feature4Body: Anonymous users see partial results; signed-in users get 3 free lookups per day; if you use it often, $1.99 once unlocks unlimited lifetime access.
About.howToUseIntro: Three steps to find the cheapest region:
About.step1Title: Search by name, paste a link, or enter an ID
About.step1Body: In the input on the All Apps page, just type an app name to search (falls back to Apple's directory if not in the library); or paste an App Store link or enter a numeric ID and hit "Add to library".
About.step2Body: The first load fetches 40 regions concurrently, usually a few seconds. After that it auto-refreshes every 6 hours, so FX rates and prices stay close to reality.
About.step3Body: The price table is sorted lowest first in your chosen currency, with the cheapest, priciest, and your own region highlighted and the gap plain to see. Which region to switch to is your call.
About.howToUseNote: Note: pricing data comes from the public App Store, converted at live exchange rates, for reference only. Actual purchases are subject to what's shown in the App Store at that time, and must comply with Apple's Terms of Service and local laws.
About.feature4BodyB: Anonymous users see partial results; sign in as a member to unlock every App, region, and tier for free — completely free.
